If you just updated your iPhone to iOS 27 and noticed the battery is draining faster than usual and the device is getting warm during normal use, you may be concerned.

There's no need to panic if this is happening to you. While these two issues do exist, they're only temporary……

Every time the system is updated to a new version of iOS, it continues to perform several tasks in the background, and this is especially noticeable after a major version update.

These background processes that consume significant CPU resources often cause the iPhone to run hotter than usual and noticeably increase battery drain. Apple has issued specific guidance on this.

The impact of iOS 27 is greater than before, because the system needs to completely rebuild the device index to accommodate Siri AI, and the whole process can take several days.

The good news is that once all the background processing is complete, the device will return to normal. In fact, iOS 27 runs more efficiently, and once all the underlying processes are updated, you may find that your battery life has improved.
